description: This file defines the Azeri (Cyrillic) culture information for the DateJS library, including date formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing, and various date manipulation methods specific to the az-Cyrl-AZ locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the numerical index of a day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the numerical index of a month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on the provided configuration.
